## Validation

- [ ] Backend: `mvn -B -ntp verify`
- [ ] Frontend: `npm install && npm run lint && npm run build`

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data are included.
- [ ] No generated build output or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Simulation determinism and event ordering are preserved, or changes are documented.
